notes: Script source of truth. Per scene and language: lines with text (captions), tts (what is spoken: respellings, sparse audio tags), anchors (name -> EN: first word containing it; ZH: substring), optional pauseAfterMs. Line ids mean the same thing in every language. The voice-over pipeline turns this into public/data/vo.<cut>.json.

_voices_doc.elevenlabs: voice (voice id), voiceName, model, stability, seeds (takes per scene; best one auto-picked), tempo (atempo), maxPause (s), pauseScale
_voices_doc.edge: voice (an edge-tts voice name), rate (e.g. '+0%'), pitch (e.g. '+0Hz'); free, no key
_voices_doc.recorded: dir (folder with one file per scene: <scene id>.<format>), format; word timings come from ASR
_voices_doc.none: no audio; timings are estimated from wpm (EN) / cps (ZH) so picture and captions can be built first

negativeStyles: busy melody that competes with narration

lines.text: Grandfather clocks tick at a steady beat. Why that beat, and not faster?

lines.text: 老式摆钟总是按固定的节拍走。为什么是这个节拍，而不是更快？

lines.text: A pendulum's swing time depends on just one thing: its length.

lines.text: The period is two pi times the square root of L over g.

lines.text: Make it four times longer, and each swing takes twice as long.
